chunks: From him, from Musa ibn Ja'far, from Abi Ja'far, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Jabbar, from Maymun, from Muhammad ibn Farah, who said:

I wrote to al-'Abd al-Salih عليه السلام asking him about certain مسائل, so he wrote back to me: Pray, after al-'Asr, whatever you wish of the nawafil, and pray, after al-Ghadah, whatever you wish of the nawafil.

key_terms.النَّوَافِلِ: supererogatory prayers beyond the obligatory salat
key_terms.الْعَبْدِ الصَّالِحِ: a title referring to the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.بَعْدَ الْغَدَاةِ: the time after the morning prayer
key_terms.مَسَائِلَ: legal or religious questions that were asked

ai.seo_question: Can missed nawafil be performed after al-'Asr and after al-Ghadah?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding making up nawafil prayers after al-'Asr and after al-Ghadah. It indicates permissibility in performing as many missed supererogatory prayers as one wishes at those times.
